title: Dashboard overview
description: Implement dashboard API endpoint that aggregates bug counts by status and priority. Build a dashboard view component with summary statistics, priority breakdown, and a recent bugs section with clickable links.
designContext: GET /api/v1/dashboard returns { total, byStatus: { open, inProgress, resolved, closed }, byPriority: { critical, high, medium, low }, recentBugs: [...top 5] }. Dashboard view shows stat cards, priority badges, and a recent bugs list. Each recent bug links to /bugs/:id.
